class NeverEarly {
  value: number;
  constructor() {
    if (false) return;
    this.value = 1;
  }
}
class ExtraReturn {
  value: number;
  constructor() {
    this.value = 2;
    return;
    return;
  }
}
class Finalizer {
  value: number;
  constructor() {
    try { return; }
    finally {
      if (false) return;
      this.value = 3;
    }
  }
}
console.log(new NeverEarly().value, new ExtraReturn().value, new Finalizer().value);
